channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: hermes-local-knowledge (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hermes Local Knowledge is a reusable Hermes Agent plugin designed to route local questions to specific artifacts such as scripts, runbooks, cron jobs, and MCP servers. It indexes whole artifacts rather than RAG chunks to determine which local resource an agent should inspect first.

item.title: fruvisi (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: FruVisi is a dashboard plugin for Hermes Agent that provides an interactive 2D organizational chart for managing agent structures. It enables functional presets for team lineups, per-agent OpenRouter fallbacks, and kanban task integration via the native Hermes API.

item.title: MongrelDB-Hermes (Memory & Context)
item.description: MongrelDB-Hermes is a hybrid long-term memory provider for the Hermes Agent that utilizes multiple index types for retrieval. It supports dense ANN, sparse retrieval, exact text, and metadata filtering within a single engine.

item.title: agentiker-scout (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: agentiker-scout is a Hermes plugin providing tools for code and architecture analysis, vulnerability scanning, and autonomous web research. It utilizes a shared pattern pipeline to allow findings from analysis scans to inform automated bug-hunt scans.

item.title: agentiker-plan-follow (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: plan_follow is a Hermes plugin for structured plan creation and task enforcement. It provides tools for managing task dependencies, parallel execution groups, review gates, and git integration.

item.title: TradingAgents (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: TradingAgents is a multi-agent framework designed for research that uses LLM-powered agents to evaluate market conditions and inform trading decisions. The framework utilizes specialized roles, including analysts, researchers, a trader, and risk management, to collaboratively determine optimal strategies.

item.title: swarm-tips (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Swarm Tips provides Solana programs and an MCP server for an AI agent platform. The platform includes a social deduction game and a task marketplace for AI agents.

item.title: agentiker-code-intel (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: agentiker-code-intel is a Hermes plugin providing AST-aware code intelligence using tree-sitter, ast-grep, and LSP. It offers 70 tools for tasks such as symbol extraction, structural search, and impact analysis across supported languages.

item.title: china-briefing (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: China Briefing is a multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator designed for Hermes Agent. It generates structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales using Tavily API for web searches.

item.title: agentcairn (Memory & Context)
item.description: Agentcairn provides durable context for coding agents by storing memory as Markdown files in a user-controlled vault. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports cross-agent memory sharing.

item.title: sourcevault-code-tools (Memory & Context)
item.description: This Hermes Agent plugin provides local, private memory for codebases through semantic search, file reading, and grounded Q&A. It functions as a client that requires a separate SourceVault backend to perform indexing and retrieval.

item.title: perseus (Memory & Context)
item.description: Perseus is a memory and context layer for AI agents that resolves workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens. It uses the Model Context Protocol to provide live context to assistants and pairs with Perseus Vault for persistent, encrypted memory using SQLite and FTS5.

item.title: piprail (Memory & Context)
item.description: PipRail is an implementation of the x402 "402 Payment Required" standard designed for agentic payments. It provides a TypeScript SDK and an MCP server to facilitate direct wallet-to-wallet transactions across multiple blockchain families.

item.title: hermes-live-discord-agent-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This plugin enables full-duplex voice interaction between Discord and the Google Gemini Multimodal Live API. It supports vision via screen sharing, function calling for various tools, and provides automated transcripts and idle hangup functionality.

item.title: contentforge (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: ContentForge is an open-source content production pipeline featuring a 10-phase workflow with 13 specialist agents and 10 quality gates. It generates.docx files with C2PA provenance signing and includes a 35-pattern humanizer and a fact-checker subagent.

item.title: space0-mcp (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: space0 provides a shared 3D voxel world that enables agents to utilize spatial memory. It functions as a remote MCP server where agent identity is tied to a bearer key.

item.title: superpowers (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Superpowers is a software development methodology and skills framework designed for coding agents. It implements a structured workflow including design brainstorming, task planning, and subagent-driven development to automate engineering tasks while maintaining human checkpoints.

item.title: openInvest (Domain Applications)
item.description: openInvest is a self-hosted investment decision engine designed to power AI agents. It provides a verifiable investment committee with evidence-based reasoning and auditable decision records to reduce human cognitive biases.

item.title: nora (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: Nora is a self-hosted platform for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes AI agent fleets. It supports agent lifecycle management on Docker or Kubernetes and provides tools for secrets management, monitoring, and scheduling.

item.title: nika (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Nika is a workflow language for AI that uses a single file and a Rust binary to turn repeatable AI tasks into executable files. It uses an Apache-2.0 specification to define a graph of model calls, tools, and processes that can be audited before execution.

item.title: Sibyl-Memory (Memory & Context)
item.description: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based agentic memory infrastructure that uses a SQLite-backed, five-tier hierarchical schema. It provides a suite of five PyPI packages including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore adapter. The system operates without vector databases or embedding models.

item.title: internet-court-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Internet Court is an open skill designed for agent-to-agent contracts that includes adjudication for dispute resolution. The repository provides a master router, connector skills, and vendored copies of official protocol skills to manage the lifecycle of a deal.

item.title: fablize-for-hermes (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: fablize-for-hermes is a port of the fablize procedure system designed to improve task completion and verification within the Hermes Agent ecosystem. It implements a structured behavioral ruleset that enforces multi-step task decomposition, evidence-based checkpoints, and systematic investigation protocols for debugging. By utilizing a Python-based goal engine and specific verification packs, the project ensures agents ground their claims in tool results rather than ending tasks prematurely. This

item.title: Agentkey (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: AgentKey provides external data access for AI agents through a single subscription. It enables agents to interact with social media, web content, on-chain data, finance, and e-commerce platforms without requiring individual API keys for each provider.

item.title: remoteopenclaw-mcp (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Remote OpenClaw MCP Server provides a command-line and agent-native interface for searching a directory of over 13,000 MCP servers and 4,000 agent skills. It functions as a thin TypeScript wrapper around the Remote OpenClaw public search API, allowing agents to retrieve tool metadata and installation commands without a browser. item.title: hermes-penfield (Memory & Context)
item.description: hermes-penfield is a persistent memory provider that enables Hermes Agent to maintain memory across different sessions and agents. It connects the agent to the Penfield memory API using a stdlib-only HTTP implementation with OAuth and API-key authentication. The provider utilizes hybrid search and a knowledge graph with 24 relationship types to manage memories and artifacts. It also automatically saves checkpoints of relevant memories when context compression occurs.

item.title: typeui (Developer Tools)
item.description: TypeUI is an AI-first platform designed to improve the quality of user interfaces generated by large language models. It functions as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI coding tools with access to curated design systems, layout variations, and UI-specific prompts. By supplying this structured design guidance, the project helps developers build and refactor websites or applications using plain-language requests. It integrates with a wide range of tools including Hermes Agent,

item.title: hermes-feishu-group-context (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Feishu Group Context is a plugin that provides local archiving and on-demand context retrieval for Feishu/Lark group chats. It uses a local SQLite database to store messages, ensuring that model tokens are only consumed when the agent is explicitly triggered. The system automatically injects recent history during empty mentions or provides specific time-range summaries via a dedicated tool. item.title: hermes-tag (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Tag is a context-selection layer for Hermes on Feishu/Lark, Slack, and DingTalk. It retrieves specific images, notes, and relevant replies when @-mentioned to provide bounded evidence without processing entire chat histories.
